title: 第021章 打个电话第022章 何红冰哭了
content_zh:
第021章打个电话
“你，其心可诛！”
看着周豪，陈默目光冰冷，摄人心魄。
这时，门外有景笛长鸣，两辆景车停在餐馆门口，惊散大批看热闹的路人。
五名身穿制服的景察，走进餐馆，迅速打量一眼现场，为首的那名中年景察看向躺在地上张虎，喝道：“张虎，又是你在闹事？”
看到这名景官，张虎像是看到了救星，立刻恶人先告状：“何景官，这次我是受害者，你可要给我和手下这些兄弟们做主啊！”
“怎么回事？你先站起来，慢慢说！”何景官一脸威严道。
有景察在，张虎和他的那些小弟们，暂时忘记了陈默的恐怖，一个个挣扎着爬起来，迅速围在张虎身旁，低着头，一脸委屈状。
张虎反咬一口：“我和兄弟们在这吃饭，没想到这小子二话不说，上来就打，结果你也看到了，要是你晚来一会，我的小命都没了。”
“胡说八道！”
一众学生顿时怒声呵斥。
“景察同志，我是这家餐馆的老板，事情并不像他说的那样，是他们收保护费在先，我们不同意，他就叫人砸我们餐馆，我女儿同学看不过去，这才出手教训了他们。”蒋瑶妈妈站出来，对何景官说道。
何景官嗯了一声，点点头，一脸严肃道：“行了，我知道了。”
然后，何景官扫了一眼陈默，问道：“人是你打的？”
张虎马上指着陈默说：“就是他！”
何景官目光冰冷，问道：“你有什么要解释的吗？”
陈默直视何景官，淡淡道：“没有。”
“那行了，把他们都带走。”何景官对着手下一挥手说道。
“等一下，景察同志，你们是不是搞错了，干嘛要带走陈默？闹事的是他们啊！”蒋瑶妈妈拦在陈默身前，紧张的问道。
何景官面无表情：“闹事的是他们，但是伤人的是他，是你这些桌椅重要，还是人命重要？”

蒋瑶妈妈顿时无言以对，望着这些景察，第一次眼中露出深深失望。
任谁都能看出，这些景察，分明偏袒张虎那些人。说不定张虎敢在这一条街上横行无忌，跟这位何景官，脱不了干系。
“带走！”何景官再次挥手，立刻，一名年轻的景察，走向陈默。
“等下，何景官，你要小心，这小子很能打的。”张虎好心提醒。
何景官冷笑一声：“能打？他能打的过枪吗？小李，实弹上膛，如果敢袭景，允许你开枪自卫！”
“是！”那名走向陈默的年轻景察，立刻拔出腰间手枪，子弹上膛。
这下，不管是赵刚等一众同学，还是蒋瑶一家，都满脸焦急。就算陈默能打，也不可能打得过枪啊！
甚至，赵刚等人还担心陈默万一冲动，会给景察开枪的理由。
content_en:
Chapter 021 Make a Call
"You have a heart that can be killed!"
Looking at Zhou Hao, Chen Mo's eyes were cold and breathtaking.
At this time, there was a siren sounding outside the door, and two landscape cars parked in front of the restaurant, startling a large number of passers-by who were watching the excitement.
Five uniformed Jingchao walked into the restaurant and quickly took a look at the scene. The middle-aged Jingchao at the head looked at Zhang Hu lying on the ground and shouted: "Zhang Hu, are you making trouble again?"
Seeing this Jingguan, Zhang Hu seemed to have seen a savior. He immediately complained: "He Jingguan, I am the victim this time. You have to make the decision for me and my brothers!"
"What's going on? Stand up first and speak slowly!" He Jingguan said with a majestic look.
With Jing Cha present, Zhang Hu and his younger brothers temporarily forgot about Chen Mo's terror. They struggled to get up one by one and quickly gathered around Zhang Hu, with their heads lowered and aggrieved expressions on their faces.
Zhang Hu bit back and said, "My brothers and I were eating here. Unexpectedly, this kid came up and beat me without saying a word. You saw the result. If you had come a little later, my life would have been lost."
"Nonsense!"
All the students immediately shouted angrily.
"Comrade Jingcha, I am the owner of this restaurant. Things are not as he said. They collected the protection money first. We didn't agree, so he asked people to smash up our restaurant. My daughter's classmates couldn't stand it, so they took action to teach them a lesson." Jiang Yao's mother stood up and said to He Jingguan.
He Jingguan hummed, nodded, and said seriously: "Okay, I understand."
Then, He Jingguan glanced at Chen Mo and asked, "Did you hit him?"
Zhang Hu immediately pointed at Chen Mo and said, "That's him!"
He Jingguan's eyes were cold and he asked, "Do you have anything to explain?"
Chen Mo looked directly at He Jingguan and said calmly: "No."
"Okay, take them all away." He Jingguan waved to his men.
"Wait a minute, Comrade Jingcha, did you make a mistake? Why did you take Chen Mo away? They are the ones making the trouble!" Jiang Yao's mother stopped in front of Chen Mo and asked nervously.
He Jingguan's face was expressionless: "They are the ones making trouble, but he is the one who hurts people. Which is more important, your desks and chairs, or human lives?"
Jiang Yao's mother was immediately speechless. Looking at these scenes, her eyes showed deep disappointment for the first time.
Anyone can see that these Jingcha are clearly biased towards Zhang Hu and the others. Maybe Zhang Hu's daring to run rampant on this street has something to do with He Jingguan.
"Take away!" He Jingguan waved again, and immediately, a young Jing Cha walked towards Chen Mo.
"Wait a minute, He Jingguan, you have to be careful, this kid is very capable of beating." Zhang Hu reminded kindly.
He Jingguan sneered: "Can he fight? Can he shoot with a gun? Xiao Li, load the gun with live ammunition. If you dare to attack Jing, you are allowed to shoot in self-defense!"
"Yes!" The young Jing Cha who walked towards Chen Mo immediately pulled out the pistol from his waist and loaded the bullet.
At this time, whether it was Zhao Gang and other classmates, or Jiang Yao's family, their faces were full of anxiety. Even if Chen Mo can fight, he can't beat a gun!
Zhao Gang and others were even worried that Chen Mo would give Jing Cha a reason to shoot him if he was impulsive.
